author: The Associated Press
title: Trump Says U.S. Will Hit Iran 'Very Hard' and Bring Country 'Back to the Stone Ages'
text:
• President Donald Trump stated that U.S. forces will continue to attack Iran in the next two or three weeks.
• Trump said he would bring Iran "back to the Stone Ages."
• Trump claimed that all of Washington's objectives have been met or exceeded.
• Trump did not provide details about potential attacks on Iran.
• Trump did not comment on the U.S. drone strike that killed Qassem Soleimani.
• Trump said the U.S. would not target Iranian cultural sites.
• Trump's comments were made in response to questions about Iran.
• Trump's statements were criticized by some.

• Trump said that the U.S. would continue to target Iranian assets.
• Trump said that the U.S. has more than 1.6T in assets.
• Trump's comments were made on Monday.
• The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at 28,907.05 on Monday.
• The S&P 500 closed at 3,276.24 on Monday.
summary: President Donald Trump said U.S. forces will keep hitting Iran “very hard” in the next two or three weeks and bring the country “back to the Stone Ages,” even as he touted the success of U.S. operations and argued that all of Washington’s objectives have so far been met or exceeded.
